title: Rina's compliance micro-planner - nightly
content:
Nightly micro-planner (brain dump)

Context: quick scratchpad for SOC2 evidence chores + lightweight vendor checks. Use this to triage tonight's handoff and to leave a clear next-step for whoever picks this up tomorrow morning. Not a final checklist — iterative.

Top priorities (short):
- [ ] S3 access-logs for backups-bucket: find last 90 days, tag objects with 'soc2-evidence/2026-03' and upload a zipped export to evidence-storage (est 30m)
  - location hint: account-redwood-prod -> s3://rw-backups-01/logs/ (confirm with infra team)
- [ ] Prod IAM user list snapshot (redwood-prod): generate CSV, include last authentication and MFA status (est 20m)
- [ ] Vendor quick-check: Datastream Inc. (contract v1) — confirm data-subprocessor clause present, flag if missing. Create short note to legal + include copy of the contract in evidence folder (est 25m)
- [ ] Policy TODO: update Data Retention draft to include exception process for legal holds (put redline in /confluence/SEC-PLAYBOOK)

Lower priority / housekeeping:
- [ ] Backup verification evidence: weekly restore logs for 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-21 (if not in evidence-storage, request via #infra-prod)
- [ ] Rotate temporary credentials list: ensure all temp keys >30d are rotated or documented
- [ ] Vendor: AnalyticsFlow — follow up on their SOC2 questionnaire answers, missing Item 6 (encryption at rest) -> email PO

Open questions / blockers:
- Where exactly did last week's S3 log export land? (asked infra in #infra-prod; ticket JIRA-1982)
- Does Datastream store derivatives or only metadata? Need product confirmation from Sam (pinged in Slack thread)
- Legal needs the contract redline by EOD Fri — can I get a 15m review with Priya? If not, mark as blocker.

Meeting notes snippet (15m stand): 2026-03-27 09:30
- Diego: infra will run an S3 inventory job tomorrow morning (ETA 09:45)
- Evelyn: has partial vendor questionnaire for AnalyticsFlow, will finish answers by Thu
- Action: I will produce IAM CSV and upload to evidence-storage by EOD

Quick commands / snippets for next person:
- aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket rw-backups-01 --prefix logs/ --query 'Contents[?LastModified>=`2026-02-26`]'
- aws iam list-users --query 'Users[*].[UserName,CreateDate]' > prod-iam-snapshot-2026-03-27.csv

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep filenames consistent: evidence-<type>-YYYY-MM-DD.zip (helps search)
- If something is ambiguous, leave a one-liner in the file and tag @Evelyn so it shows up in her backlog
- Try to automate the S3 export next sprint (ticket idea: AUTO-EVIDENCE-1)

Draft email templates (for quick copy/paste):
- To Legal (contract missing clause):
  Subject: Datastream Inc. — data-subprocessor clause missing / action needed
  Body: Hi Priya, I reviewed Datastream's contract (v1) and couldn't find the data-subprocessor clause we require for SOC2 evidence. Can you advise if a standard addendum exists, or should we request an amendment? Attaching contract. Thanks, Rina

- To Vendor (questionnaire follow-up):
  Subject: AnalyticsFlow — SOC2 questionnaire follow-up
  Body: Quick follow-up: item 6 (encryption at rest) is incomplete in the questionnaire. Can you confirm encryption-at-rest details for the production environment and provide any supporting docs?

Quick log (what I did today):
- pulled partial IAM CSV and started S3 search (stopped at 45m — infra job will finish)
- skimmed Datastream contract, flagged missing clause
- left note for Diego about the inventory job

Ideas / future improvements (one-line):
- small lambda to snapshot IAM users daily into evidence-storage (low-effort)
- automate vendor questionnaire reminders (weekly digest)
- add a Confluence page with canonical filenames and a tiny script to validate evidence uploads

If you pick this up: prioritize the S3 logs and IAM snapshot. Leave a one-line update at top of file (timestamp + name).

-- Rina
